$comment: CLI <-> PLATFORM contract (v3.3.0). Copied into platform.json as `bootstrap` at release build. protocol: version of the launcher->engine interface (a release whose protocol is higher than the CLI speaks is refused). minCliVersion: oldest public CLI this release's engine supports. requiredCapabilities: what the CLI must offer BEFORE trust exists (a legacy v3.2.0 CLI, which sends nothing, is assumed to offer exactly ["adopt"]). Raising any of these is a compatibility decision: see governance/versioning/VERSIONING-POLICY.md.
